description: Ride booking data containing information about ride bookings, cancellations, ratings, and payments

columns.name: BOOKING_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each ride booking

columns.name: BOOKING_STATUS
columns.description: Status of booking (Completed, Cancelled by Customer, Cancelled by Driver, No Driver Found, Incomplete)

columns.name: VEHICLE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of vehicle (Go Mini, Go Sedan, Auto, eBike/Bike, UberXL, Premier Sedan)

columns.name: AVG_VTAT
columns.description: Average time for driver to reach pickup location (in minutes)

columns.name: AVG_CTAT
columns.description: Average trip duration from pickup to destination (in minutes)

columns.name: BOOKING_VALUE
columns.description: Total fare amount for the ride
columns.note: Use CAST(BOOKING_VALUE AS REAL) for numeric operations

columns.name: RIDE_DISTANCE
columns.description: Distance covered during the ride (in km)
columns.note: Use CAST(RIDE_DISTANCE AS REAL) for numeric operations

columns.name: PAYMENT_METHOD
columns.description: Method used for payment (UPI, Cash, Credit Card, Uber Wallet, Debit Card)

data_quality_notes: Numeric columns (BOOKING_VALUE, RIDE_DISTANCE, AVG_VTAT, AVG_CTAT, DRIVER_RATINGS, CUSTOMER_RATING) are FLOAT — use directly, no casting needed
Never use TRY_CAST — columns are already numeric
BOOKING_VALUE is NULL for cancelled/incomplete/no-driver rides — only Completed rides have a value
BOOKING_STATUS values: 'Completed', 'Cancelled by Driver', 'No Driver Found', 'Cancelled by Customer', 'Incomplete'
CUSTOMER_ID values look like CID1234567 and BOOKING_ID values look like CNR1234567

CRITICAL — Snowflake NULL ordering: ORDER BY col DESC puts NULLs FIRST by default. ALWAYS append NULLS LAST when ordering by nullable columns such as BOOKING_VALUE, RIDE_DISTANCE, DRIVER_RATINGS, CUSTOMER_RATING

common_queries.top_customers_by_spend: SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, SUM(BOOKING_VALUE) AS total_spend FROM RIDEBOOKING WHERE BOOKING_VALUE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY total_spend DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
common_queries.daily_aggregation: SELECT DATE, COUNT(*) AS total_bookings, AVG(BOOKING_VALUE) AS avg_booking_value FROM RIDEBOOKING WHERE BOOKING_VALUE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE ORDER BY DATE
common_queries.vehicle_type_analysis: SELECT VEHICLE_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS bookings, AVG(RIDE_DISTANCE) AS avg_distance FROM RIDEBOOKING WHERE RIDE_DISTANCE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY VEHICLE_TYPE ORDER BY avg_distance DESC NULLS LAST
common_queries.cancellation_analysis: SELECT BOOKING_STATUS, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM RIDEBOOKING GROUP BY BOOKING_STATUS ORDER BY cnt DESC
